description: This Kotlin source file defines the NextcloudViewModel class, which manages the interaction logic for Nextcloud synchronization, such as URL validation, user authentication, and preference handling within an Android MVVM architecture.

classes.name: NextcloudViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing Nextcloud synchronization settings and authentication, interfacing with repositories and preferences to perform URL validation, credential management, and data cleanup.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Validates and sets the Nextcloud server URL, updating preferences and clearing mappings if the URL has changed.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication against the Nextcloud server using provided credentials, updating stored preferences and clearing ID mappings upon successful validation.
